problem_statement: The kernel needs a way for a supervisor thread to revoke access to a kernel object from every other thread at once. A new API, k_object_access_revoke_others(), called from supervisor mode on a kernel object, must remove all other threads' permissions on that object and also revert any public ('access-all') state that was previously set via k_object_access_all_grant(). After the call, no other thread should have access to the object (a permission check from any other thread returns -EPERM), even when the object had been made public. The caller's own access is retained. When userspace is not configured, the API is a no-op.
